Welcome to the United States Department of Labor

Learn more about our work

Featured Stories

Celebrating Value and Talent

Join us in celebrating National Disability Employment Awareness Month!

The Apprenticeship Advantage

Learn how you can earn a paycheck while training for an in-demand job with a Registered Apprenticeship.

Self-Audit Programs

Learn how our self-audit programs can help employers, unions, and benefits plans managers proactively improve compliance.

Disaster Recovery Assistance

Have you been affected by a wildfire, flood or other disaster? We can help with wages and benefits, staying safe during cleanup efforts and more.
